in_arabic.name: Jamlah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Jamlah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Islamic tradition, Jamlah is derived from the Arabic root 'j-m-l' which means 'to gather' or 'collection'. The name symbolizes unity and bringing together of loved ones. It also holds spiritual significance as mentioned in Hadith where Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used the term 'Jamlah' to refer to gathering of believers for prayer.
